effective_scope: future untouched V16B SIGNAL windows only; never retroactive; no backfill or late seal
decision_basis: source/provenance completeness and consistency only; no V16B outcome, ranking, realized PnL, external Delta or future executability used

asset_to_market_identity_policy.mapping_source: exact Binance Spot exchangeInfo captured for the SIGNAL window
asset_to_market_identity_policy.eligible_exchange_symbol_rule: status=TRADING AND quoteAsset=USDT AND baseAsset exactly equals the CMC symbol
asset_to_market_identity_policy.cmc_symbol_uniqueness_rule: CMC symbol must be unique within the exact PIT Top-150 snapshot; duplicate CMC symbols are all unmapped
asset_to_market_identity_policy.exchange_match_uniqueness_rule: exactly one Binance Spot USDT symbol must match; zero or multiple matches are unmapped
asset_to_market_identity_policy.aliases_or_symbol_transforms: none; no alias, multiplier, prefix, suffix, rename or heuristic normalization is permitted
asset_to_market_identity_policy.mapping_time: mapping is determined from exchangeInfo captured after the Thursday daily bar is closed and before SIGNAL_SEAL

daily_price_source.source: Binance Spot Market Data Only REST
daily_price_source.instrument: exact frozen mapped Binance Spot USDT symbol

volume_usd_semantics.raw_field: quote asset volume from Binance Spot 1d kline
volume_usd_semantics.derived_volume_usd: numeric quote asset volume in USDT units; no FX conversion and no synthetic reconstruction
volume_usd_semantics.threshold_interpretation: the already-frozen 10,000,000/day liquidity threshold is applied to this source-specific USDT quote-volume measure
volume_usd_semantics.missing_or_nonfinite: feature row fails completeness; no imputation

benchmark_identity.source: same 1d kline endpoint and same causal cutoff as candidate assets

market_available_but_not_in_cmc_pit_poli.reason: CMC PIT Top-150 remains the frozen universe authority; exchange listing cannot expand it

source_availability_and_cutoff.bar_rule: use only fully closed 1d klines whose closeTime is <= signal_day 23:59:59.999 UTC
source_availability_and_cutoff.capture_rule: Binance /api/v3/time must be >= the next UTC midnight before market-data capture is accepted
source_availability_and_cutoff.seal_rule: all market-source evidence must be captured and hash-bound after the signal-day bar closes and before SIGNAL_SEAL; SIGNAL_SEAL remains before Friday UTC close
source_availability_and_cutoff.cmc_rule: CMC PIT snapshot itself must already satisfy the existing requirement of demonstrable availability by Thursday UTC close

preserve_raw: Binance kline response for every mapped symbol including BTCUSDT
provenance_contract.panel_binding: feature-panel manifest must bind the SIGNAL market-source manifest hash for CURRENT_PROSPECTIVE_PIT rows
provenance_contract.signal_binding: prospective SIGNAL input_data_hashes must include the feature-panel manifest and SIGNAL market-source manifest hashes
provenance_contract.canonicalization: derived CSV outputs use deterministic sorting and LF line endings
